patterns.note: A clean, grid-based layout is used for portfolio items and ventures, typically in two or three columns, with consistent spacing and card-like presentation for each item.
Headings utilize a very large, bold sans-serif typeface for strong visual impact, contrasting with a more moderately sized, readable sans-serif for body text.
The site primarily uses a high-contrast palette of off-white backgrounds and black text/CTAs, with subtle light and dark grays for secondary elements and borders.
The announcement banner at the very top of the page disappears on scroll, while the main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport without changing its appearance.
Sections are clearly delineated by generous vertical spacing and prominent, centered headings, often followed by a brief introductory paragraph.

technique_notes: The site employs a fixed header that remains visible at the top of the screen as the user scrolls, while a temporary announcement bar above it is designed to hide after an initial scroll action. Content below the hero section is presented in a series of distinct blocks, with portfolio and venture items arranged in responsive grids, each item contained within a card-like structure with a subtle border and consistent internal padding. Typography is used to establish a clear hierarchy, with oversized, bold headings drawing attention to new sections and a more restrained, readable font for body copy and descriptive text.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) create strong visual anchors, paired with a standard, readable sans-serif for body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., ~4-8px) are consistently applied to buttons, images, and card elements, contributing to a modern, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, ensuring content breathes while grid items maintain a consistent, tighter rhythm.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its confident use of extremely large, bold typography for primary headings, which immediately establishes a strong, professional presence. This is combined with a very clean, almost stark, high-contrast color palette and a structured grid layout, creating an impression of clarity and directness that avoids typical marketing fluff.
